// DecideSuppression applies only to lower-risk categories. P0, security, and
// logic findings always remain visible regardless of feedback history.
func DecideSuppression(finding SuppressionFinding, events []NoiseEvent, config SuppressionConfig, now time.Time) (SuppressionDecision, error) {
if finding.Path == "" || !map[string]bool{"P0": true, "P1": true, "P2": true}[finding.Severity] || finding.Category == "" || now.IsZero() {
return SuppressionDecision{}, errors.New("finding path, severity, category, and current time are required")
return SuppressionDecision{Reason: "protected finding categories are never auto-suppressed"}, nil
return SuppressionDecision{}, errors.New("suppression threshold cannot be lower than three")
return SuppressionDecision{}, errors.New("suppression window is invalid")
return SuppressionDecision{}, errors.New("suppression path glob is invalid")
return SuppressionDecision{Reason: "finding is outside the configured path scope"}, nil

if event.ID <= 0 || seen[event.ID] || event.Category != finding.Category || event.OccurredAt.Before(cutoff) || event.OccurredAt.After(now) || (event.Kind != "ignored" && event.Kind != "thumbs_down") {
sort.Slice(decision.EvidenceIDs, func(i, j int) bool { return decision.EvidenceIDs[i] < decision.EvidenceIDs[j] })
decision.Reason = "eligible category repeatedly ignored or downvoted in scope"

events := []NoiseEvent{{ID: 1, Category: "style", Path: "src/a.go", Kind: "ignored", OccurredAt: now.Add(-time.Hour)}, {ID: 2, Category: "style", Path: "src/b.go", Kind: "thumbs_down", OccurredAt: now.Add(-2 * time.Hour)}, {ID: 3, Category: "style", Path: "src/c.go", Kind: "ignored", OccurredAt: now.Add(-3 * time.Hour)}}
decision, err := DecideSuppression(SuppressionFinding{Severity: "P2", Category: "style", Path: "src/new.go"}, events, SuppressionConfig{PathGlob: "src/*"}, now)

events := []NoiseEvent{{ID: 1, Category: "security", Path: "a.go", Kind: "thumbs_down", OccurredAt: now}, {ID: 2, Category: "security", Path: "a.go", Kind: "thumbs_down", OccurredAt: now}, {ID: 3, Category: "security", Path: "a.go", Kind: "thumbs_down", OccurredAt: now}}
decision, err := DecideSuppression(SuppressionFinding{Severity: "P2", Category: "security", Path: "a.go"}, events, SuppressionConfig{}, now)

explanations.title: Critical categories stay visible
explanations.summary: P0 findings and findings categorized as security or logic remain visible regardless of feedback history, so repeated ignores or downvotes cannot suppress them.

explanations.title: Repeated feedback can suppress findings
explanations.summary: Eligible findings can now be hidden after at least three distinct, recent ignore or thumbs-down events for the same category. The default lookback is 30 days. When a path glob is configured, feedback from any path matching that glob counts toward the finding, rather than only feedback from the finding’s exact path.
